Done. I've implemented all three functions:

1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in `src/num.js` — returns n clamped to the range [min, max]
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** in `src/util.js` — formats byte counts as human-readable strings (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place
3. **`slugify(title)`** in `src/text.js` — converts titles to URL-friendly slugs (lowercase, trim, spaces→dashes, strip non-alphanumeric except dashes)

All are exported from their respective modules.
